message: Bare except forbidden — catch specific exception types

evaluator_config.message_template: Bare 'except:' forbidden — catch specific exception types

rationale: Specific exception catching ensures that only anticipated failures are handled gracefully. Bare except clauses catch everything including SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt, masking real errors.
remediation: Catch specific exception types. Use 'except Exception:' as a last-resort safety net only, logging at ERROR/CRITICAL level.

guidance.explanation: The correct version catches specific exception types (Timeout, ConnectionError). The incorrect version uses bare except, which catches SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt, masking real errors.
